title: Where are you the most in your dreams?
content: I have a few places that I frequent more often than others when I dream and I'm curious if folks have similar regular spots that they find themselves in recurring dreams as well? For example: I regularly find myself in a grocery store, a hotel, a sprawling mall, a school, a movie theater, a ship, a restaurant I used to work at and a large pool. I revisit each of these places frequently and some of them seem to carry on and change autonomously in my absence. Where are you the most and what do you do there?
